Train the structural (home-frame) win probability model

Source: R/wp_structural.R
train_wp_structural.Rd

Fits \(H\) = P(home team wins; draw = 0.5) from home score margin, time remaining, red-card difference, half, extra time and the pre-match Elo gap, optionally plus who has the ball. See predict_wp for how \(H\) becomes the possession team's win chance, and panna#273 for why. Nrounds is chosen by 5-fold match-grouped CV with early stopping, as in train_wp_model.

Usage

train_wp_structural(
  wp_features,
  use_possession = TRUE,
  nrounds = 600L,
  max_depth = 4L,
  eta = 0.1,
  nfolds = 5L,
  min_child_weight = 50L,
  early_stopping_rounds = 20L,
  seed = 42L,
  weight = NULL,
  extra_features = character()
)

predict_wp_structural(wp_model, wp_features, team_agnostic = FALSE)

Arguments

wp_features

Output of create_wp_features with wp_label, joined to Elo by add_wp_match_elo.

use_possession

Add home_has_ball as an input (default TRUE: the SEP model Pete chose 2026-11-10). With strength in the model this measures what possession is worth beyond team quality; 2026-11-10 EPL hold-out: 1.6 points, no gain in log loss.

nrounds, max_depth, eta, nfolds, min_child_weight, early_stopping_rounds, seed

XGBoost / CV settings.

weight

Optional per-row training weights (same length as the rows kept after dropping NA labels), e.g. to undo row subsampling.

extra_features

Names of further numeric columns in wp_features to use as inputs, in the HOME frame or frame-free (e.g. minutes into stoppage time). No monotone constraint; NA allowed. Stored on the model, so prediction needs the same columns.

wp_model

A model from train_wp_structural().

team_agnostic

Score with every team-strength input set to 0 – the Elo gap and, when the model has it, the starting-XI gap xi_diff – i.e. as if the two teams were equally strong (the site's team-agnostic WPA view). Home advantage stays in.

Value

A list of class panna_wp_structural with model, feature_names, use_possession, cv_logloss, optimal_nrounds and type = "structural".

predict_wp_structural(): the possession team's win chance per row, live threat included via the next-goal mixture.
